title: Donruss 1991 Mark McGwire Lot Of 2 #105 & BC-9 Highlights Oakland Athletics
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Sports Trading Cards:Trading Card Lots
descriptionText: The product is a lot of 2 vintage Donruss 1991 Mark McGwire trading cards featuring the player in his Oakland Athletics uniform. These baseball cards are part of the base set for the 1991 season and showcase McGwire during his time with the team. As a parallel/variety in the collection, these cards are highly sought after by collectors of sports trading cards, especially those interested in the Major League Baseball player. Manufactured by Donruss in the United States, these cards are a valuable addition to any sports memorabilia collection.
